source: Finder 27.2.1 (26B131), Gallery view, dummy folder of 8 items, window 1000x700 pt at 200,100 (display 1440x932 @2x) and 1400x900 pt at 150,60 (display 1710x1107, still 2x). AX = from AX frames; px = measured on the 2x window shots.

fonts_ax.note: AX AXForegroundColor is resolved in the dark appearance in both modes (white with alpha 0.847 / 0.549 even in light), so only the alpha tells label (0.847) from secondaryLabel (0.549); take colours from pixels
fonts_ax.name: not exposed (AXStaticText without AXAttributedStringForRange); px estimate below

fonts_px_estimate.name: about 16 pt (ink width 71 pt for 'Alpine.jpg'; AX does not expose the attributed string)
fonts_px_estimate.Show More: 11 pt regular, accent colour (darkest ink px 43,102,211 light)
fonts_px_estimate.quick action labels: 11 pt regular (ink widths: More… 34 pt, Markup 38 pt, Rotate Left 56.5 pt)
fonts_px_estimate.quick action glyphs: about 14x14 pt ink, label baseline about 26 pt below glyph top

selected_thumb_plate_px.shape: square plate 54x54 pt = thumb frame outset 3 pt on all sides, drawn behind the thumbnail (visible as a 3 pt ring around square thumbs, fully visible around landscape images)
selected_thumb_plate_px.corner_fit: circular arc fit on 2x pixels, r = 14 px (dark fit error 0.15)

preview_image_px.fit: aspect fit centred in the preview frame
preview_image_px.hairline_border: 1 px, darker than the image in light, lighter in dark

inspector_colours_px.note: column colour is a translucent material tinted by the wallpaper (it shows blurred strip content when the strip runs under it in a narrow window)
